description: Run an ADQL (SQL) query against NSF NOIRLab Astro Data Lab, the DECam, Mayall and Blanco survey catalogues (Legacy Surveys/DECaLS, DES, DELVE, DECaPS, SMASH, NSC) alongside the all-sky catalogues queryable alongside them (Gaia DR3, AllWISE, CatWISE, 2MASS, SDSS, DESI). AUTHORITATIVE for catalogue-level astronomy at scale: these are the survey teams' own reduced photometry and astrometry, tens of billions of rows, joinable across surveys in a single query, which no web page or per-object API can

examples.sql: SELECT ra, dec, phot_g_mean_mag FROM gaia_dr3.gaia_source WHERE phot_g_mean_mag < 6

limit.description: Row ceiling injected as SELECT TOP n when the query has none (default 100, max 1000).

sql.description: An ADQL SELECT. Tables are fully qualified schema.table, e.g. "SELECT ra, dec, phot_g_mean_mag FROM gaia_dr3.gaia_source WHERE phot_g_mean_mag < 12". Row limits use ADQL's "SELECT TOP n", not "LIMIT n". ADQL geometry functions (CONTAINS/POINT/CIRCLE) are NOT available here, use datalab_cone_search instead.

name: noirlab-datalab__datalab_query
